description:
Affiliate Program Overview for Adivasi Hair Oil

Brand Introduction:
Adivas.org is a pioneer in natural hair care solutions, dedicated to offering high-quality, organic hair oils crafted with traditional Adivasi wisdom. Our flagship product, Adivasi Herbal Hair Oil, is renowned for its powerful blend of natural herbs, promoting healthy, vibrant hair. We are committed to sustainability and use ethically sourced ingredients to ensure the best for our customers and the environment.

Product Description:
Adivasi Herbal Hair Oil is a potent Ayurvedic formula designed to address all your hair concerns. Infused with nature’s finest herbs, this hair oil promotes hair growth, reduces hair fall, eliminates dandruff, and soothes dry scalp. It revitalizes and nourishes your hair, giving you the healthy, shiny hair you’ve always desired. Suitable for all hair types, our oil is free from harmful chemicals and synthetic additives.

USP (Unique Selling Point):
- 100% natural and organic ingredients
- Ayurvedic formula with proven efficacy
- Addresses multiple hair issues: growth, fall, dandruff, dry scalp
- Free from harmful chemicals and synthetic additives
- Ethically sourced ingredients with a commitment to sustainability
- Free shipping across India

Payment Terms:
Affiliates earn a competitive commission on every sale generated through their referral link. Payments are made on a monthly basis, with earnings transferred to your PayPal, Paytm, or UPI account. Detailed performance reports are provided to help you track your sales and commissions.

Other Information:
- Affiliate Support: Comprehensive support and resources to help you succeed, including marketing materials, product images, and promotional content.
- Easy Tracking: Our affiliate program uses advanced tracking technology to ensure accurate recording of your referrals and commissions.
- Promotional Opportunities: Affiliates can leverage special promotions and discounts to drive more sales and increase earnings.
- Flexibility: Promote Adivasi Herbal Hair Oil on various platforms, including blogs, social media, and websites.
- Dedicated Affiliate Manager: A dedicated manager to assist you with any queries and provide personalized support to maximize your success.

Join our affiliate program today and start earning by promoting a product that combines tradition, nature, and efficacy. For more information, contact us at info@adivas.org.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to Adivas.Org! Thank you for joining our Affiliate Program.

The following terms and conditions apply to individuals accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use products or services from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, the Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and is bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

---

1. Approval or Rejection of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration at our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupons

An affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later clicks on yours, yours is the one that counts.

An affiliate might or might not be assigned a coupon code, with details and usage clarified on the Dashboard. If a customer both clicks on the affiliate link and uses a coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliates may also advertise the merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram, or offline channels like classified ads, magazines, and newspapers.

3. Commissions and Payments

When you refer a customer who makes a purchase on our website, you will earn a commission based on the Commission Structure. The commission amount is dependent on the order value, excluding any extra fees (tax, shipping costs, etc.).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details in the Settings. The payment schedule will be notified on the Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy, which gives the merchant the right to review each and every referral order. The status of commissions is displayed in the Commission tab; any paid commission will be listed in the Payment tab. Transactions that result in chargebacks or refunds will not be paid out.

4. Marketing Tools

We may share promotional media such as banners, logos, or specific collection promotions with you through the Marketing Tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code to share on affiliate channels.

5. Network

If the Network tab is activated, affiliates can invite others to become their downline affiliates. If any downline affiliate generates an order for the merchant shop, the upline affiliate will also receive a network commission, which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share the network link. Any affiliate who clicks on that link and signs up will become a downline affiliate.

6. Cookies

We use cookies to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to have cookies enabled for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies, we can't track them and therefore can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookie duration is specified on the Affiliate Registration form. The tracking period will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or uses the coupon. Within the cookie period, every order made by this customer on the merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link again).

7. Removal from the Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: care.adivas@gmail.com.

---

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document. We wish you all the very best. You can always revisit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future, and if you have any questions, you can send an email to care.adivas@gmail.com for support.
